outcome: Preferred mode of delivery for next birth
cohort: 3006 women in Pennsylvania who had their first childbirth between 2009-2011
finding: While nearly half of the women who had a cesarean in their first birth preferred VBAC for their next delivery, there is a significant disparity between preference and actual VBAC rates.
mod_finding: Nearly half of respondents preferred VBAC in future births.
